Input reference is identity/style only: keep EXACT King black spiky hair, red scarf, slate blue tunic, silver hem, brown gloves and boots, cute chibi proportions, black pixel edges. Generate transparent sprite sheet 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen full-body sprites equally spaced, no labels no shadows no weapons. All face RIGHT side-three-quarter, identical body proportions and palette. Never crop or touch neighbouring cells. Each body about 220 pixels tall with generous transparent cell margins. Stable pelvis and head alignment within cells, low 2px bob, believable RUN legs visibly alternate, not repeated same crouch.
Rows1/2 form eight consecutive phases: 0 contact NEAR bright leg forward planted, FAR dark leg behind; 1 down near knee compresses with far heel lifting behind; 2 passing near support foot beneath hips, far bent knee travels forward; 3 flight near leg behind and far leg stretches forward; 4 opposite contact FAR dark leg forward and NEAR leg behind; 5 opposite down far knee compresses near heel lifts behind; 6 opposite passing far support foot below hips, near bent knee travels forward; 7 flight far leg back near leg forward leading naturally to0. Make leg crossings and alternating bent-knee passing poses unmistakable. Free arms pump oppositely, backpack/weapon absent.
Rows3/4: exact same eight LEG phases and torso registration, but RIGHT gloved fist stays by BACK shoulder to hold a huge sword later composited. Left free arm pumps modestly. Shoulder fist MUST NOT jump sideways between frames. Still weapon-free bodies. Balanced clean pixel sprite work, same light from upper left and black outline as reference. Real anatomical sequence rather than eight variants of the same leg split. Transparent background.
passing: Use case identity-preserve. Use supplied King run sheet as EXACT character/pixel style reference.
